li.label: awful house
li.description: My house is a hovel. I deserve better than this.

li.label: dull house
li.description: My house is drab and uninviting.

li.label: decent house
li.description: My house is decent enough. It's good to have a place of my own.

li.label: slightly impressive house
li.description: My house is rather nice. It's good to come home to.

li.label: somewhat impressive house
li.description: My house is impressive. I'm proud to live there.

li.label: very impressive house
li.description: My house is very impressive. I'm proud to call it mine.

li.label: extremely impressive house
li.description: My house is extremely impressive. People must envy me.

li.label: unbelievably impressive house
li.description: My house is unbelievably impressive. It's practically a manor.

li.label: wondrously impressive house
li.description: I live in a wondrous home. Few nobles live so well.

li.label: palatial house
li.description: My home is a palace. No bedroom, however grand, could compare to living like this.

li.label: living with my family
li.description: I share my home with family. It's good to have them close.

li.label: our family under one roof
li.description: My partner and children all live under our roof. This is what I work for.

li.label: no bathroom in my house
li.description: My house has no toilet and nowhere to wash. It's hardly civilised living.

li.label: no toilet in my house
li.description: My house has no toilet of its own. Queuing for the communal one is beneath me.

li.label: no place to wash at home
li.description: There's nowhere to wash up in my house. I have to traipse elsewhere just to feel clean.

li.label: a proper bathroom at home
li.description: My house has its own toilet and somewhere to wash. Now this is civilised living.

li.label: filthy house
li.description: My house is filthy. I should tidy it up.

li.label: disgustingly filthy house
li.description: My house is absolutely disgusting. I can't live like this.

li.label: no house of my own
li.description: Others have houses of their own, but I have nowhere to call home.

li.label: homeless
li.description: I've been without a home of my own for a long time. Doesn't anyone care?

li.label: stranger in my house
li.description: Someone was poking around my house uninvited. What were they after?

li.label: relaxed at home
li.description: I spent some time relaxing in my own home. There's no place like it.

li.label: visited a friend's home
li.description: I dropped in on a friend at their house. It was lovely to be welcomed in.

li.label: had a guest over
li.description: A friend came to visit my home. It felt good to play host.
